description: This script is a test suite for verifying the behavior of Git's revision listing and object integrity checks, particularly handling corrupted commit objects and ensuring that certain Git commands fail as expected.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the provided commands to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
